description: fz_engine::WorkStartReason (crates/fz-engine/src/scheduler.rs ~78, moved by fz-t93.1) spells compiler reasons inside the generic engine: Ignition, ChangedRevisionWake, ActivationPublished, GateExpansion, BlockedWaiterExpansion, Unclassified; WorkStartTally is a fixed array over them, and telemetry (jsonl.rs, causal.rs, public_trace) spells them. The engine should know only the reasons it originates itself (establish which: e.g. a changed-revision wake) and carry the client's reasons opaquely (a type the client supplies, e.g. an associated type on the client trait, or WorkStart<R> = Engine(..) | Client(R)). Acceptance: the engine source names no compiler concept; telemetry spelling and every work-start census/pin identical (work_start_reason_test.rs, distill_telemetry_test); no shims. Docs: crates/fz-engine/README.md client contract; fact-engine.md where reasons are described.
title: The engine names only its own reasons for starting work; the client names the rest
